brief: Two-storey frame store of about 1865 with a false-front parapet, a shopfront of large windows and a side door to the upstairs. Record: 1 photo plus 4 measured drawing sheets.

facade.notes: a frame store (Cairo IL, 1865): a two-storey gable-front clapboard store with a cornice return, a traditional storefront of paired glazed doors with transoms around a recessed entry, a 'ROOMS / BOARD' sign; a globe street lamp

why.note: frame stores outside the brick fire limits
